BiblicalUsage: Shuchami is a Shuhamite, a member of Shucham's family of Dan, and the census counts them all: sixty-four thousand and four hundred souls, the families of Dan after their families. The name appears twice, in the numbering and in the sum.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every family in the census had a name and a number, and God counts twice because He does not lose one.
